release: TV Identity Compatibility & Library Integrity Review
name: TV Identity Compatibility & Library Integrity Review
changes: Keeps v3.6.42 exact TV series-prefix anchoring but accepts one or two year-only decorations between an already-exact title and Sxx/Eyy, covering diagnostic-proven Reacher/Beast Games/FROM/Dark Matter release naming without reopening cross-series matches.
Adds bounded full-token stylization compatibility such as PLUR1BUS -> Pluribus while retaining exact-prefix semantics and rejecting arbitrary intervening words.

Adds an on-demand Library Integrity Needs Review interface with provenance, current path, cross-title duplicate evidence, Open Folder, and explicit Mark Missing actions; no media is deleted or moved automatically.
Mark Missing persists an exact reviewed path/fingerprint exclusion so periodic scans cannot immediately reattach the same known-bad file; a genuinely different replacement remains eligible.
Reduces /api/diagnostics payload duplication by returning full Downloads telemetry/statistics/engine state plus bounded compact collection evidence instead of the entire Downloads history.
Suppresses only proven localhost client-disconnect write exceptions so browser reloads do not get mislabeled as Automation sidebar/summary failures.
regression_guards: The strict pre-Sxx/Eyy series identity boundary remains mandatory; The Morning Show/Love Island, Bradshaw, Debrief, Romania, cross-edition, and FROM episode-title collision cases stay rejected.
Year compatibility permits only one or two 19xx/20xx tokens after an exact allowed series prefix; arbitrary words remain rejected.
Integrity review mutations alter NewzDeck library association state only and never delete, move, rename, or overwrite the reviewed media file.
Reviewed-file scan exclusion is fingerprint-specific so a newly replaced physical file at the same path can be reconciled normally.
The full /api/downloads endpoint remains authoritative and unchanged; only /api/diagnostics duplicates less historical presentation data.
v3.6.42 storage-reserve, reservation hygiene, strict library scan ownership, Win64 memory telemetry and SAB warning classification remain intact.
v3.6.41 fail-soft Downloads snapshot behavior and the v3.6.20+ serialized SAB control transport remain intact.
